question: What is the right format and process for the Cerebro Chronicle — a newspaper-style record of engineering activity that Daniel curates and stakeholders consume via cerebro-mcp?
context: Session 33 produced massive output: Slack marketplace plugin, StepProof governance, nightingale-forge, 13 incidents cataloged, case study printed. None of this is legible to stakeholders. Michael and Alex don't read git logs. The Chronicle is a newspaper-style publication: AI-drafted, Daniel-curated, stakeholder-consumed via cerebro-mcp. First edition prints today. Format should look like an old broadsheet — headlines, datelines, shipping manifests. No code needed — Claude Code drafts it, Daniel approves it, it gets printed and ingested into cerebro-mcp.
